test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

The judge commanded them to call the first witness.

options.text: “Call the first witness,” said the judge.
The first witness was commanded to come in.
“Please call the first witness,” the judge pleaded.
The judge commanded the first witness to come in.

solution:
The correct answer is** option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in** indirect speech**.
 
• Changing an indirect command to a direct command requires:
 
 
• Identifying the commanding party, here it is **"the judge"**.
 
• The command structure: as** 'commanded'** transitions direct speech, it maintains a commanding tone but the verb itself is replaced by **'said'**.
 
• It changes from a reported command to direct quotation of the order.
 
• The command **“to call the first witness”** becomes a direct quote of the order.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct direct speech is: *“Call the first witness,” said the judge.***
